messages:
sam: Alert from SLOs - hosted-infer-us-east p99 jumped to 1.8s and 5xx fraction from 0.2% -> 3.6% starting ~23:10 UTC. Multiple customer escalations. Support INC-4821.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] hosted-infer-us-east - p99 latency breach | 5xx-rate 3.6% | alert_id=ALRT-9921

eva: correlating... I see a token-rotation job around 23:09:30 UTC. Auth logs show rotation success but gateway logs spike with "no auth header" and several `upstream reset`.

josh: confirmed: auth-service v2.4.1 rolled out 23:08-23:12. We switched to canonical header `authorization` and turned off legacy acceptor.

nora: support-ops: multiple customers timeout for embeddings, sample req ids: req_8f1a req_d3b2. Responses show 502 body `upstream read timeout`.

eva: quick repro inside VPC:
```
curl -v -H "x-rd-token: bad" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}' https://inference.us-east.redwood/api/generate
```
returned 502 `upstream read timeout` when header absent/renamed.

sam: so header normalization gone wrong. Is there a fallback to legacy header? Did we flip the flag prematurely?

josh: middleware change drops unknown auth headers. The feature-flag `auth.legacy_header` was set to `false` at 23:07; should have been toggled after rollout.

nora: customers asking for ETA. Can we flip the flag back and do a slow restart of gateway to recover?

eva: tracing: root spans present but downstream auth-service spans missing for ~45% of requests in 23:09-23:14 window. Suggests early drop.

oncall-bot: PD incident PD-5492 created for SLO burn. Escalating to eng-sre.

josh: mitigation plan:
1) set `auth.legacy_header=true` via config rollout (~2m propagation)
2) if needed, rollback auth-service
3) patch gateway to accept both headers + emit telemetry tag when normalization occurs

sam: Eva, post the dashboard queries and log filters we'll use to confirm.

eva: filters to watch:
- gateway 5xx: `source:gateway env:us-east status:5xx | count_over_time(1m)`
- auth drops: `service:gateway message:"missing auth header" | count()`
Kicked `auth.legacy_header=true` at 23:22 UTC. Monitoring.

nora: updated INC-4821 and informed customers to include `x-rd-token` as workaround. CS requesting postmortem.

josh: metrics improving: 5xx fraction from 3.6% -> 0.4% over 6 minutes. p99 down to 540ms. Will watch 30m.

sam: action items for postmortem:
- josh: gateway header-compat patch + automation
- eva: collect traces, logs, screenshots
- nora: customer communications + postmortem draft

support-ops: compiling affected customer list and logs.

josh: add integration test simulating token rotation edge case for header normalization.

sam: agreed. Will close thread once postmortem link uploaded. :thumbsup:
